review_evidence: README identifies LiveLeanTriathlon as a Lean 4 benchmark of mathematical theorems spanning varied mathematical fields and research-level sources.
The public repository deliberately strips informal and formal proofs to avoid leakage but retains LiveLeanTriathlonSorry/<TheoremName>/All.lean theorem statements and supporting formal interfaces.
Formal theorem statements remain prior art under FILTER-001/FILTER-009 even when proofs are absent or replaced by sorry, so the benchmark source remains corpus-relevant.
summary: Retain LiveLeanTriathlon: even in the public proof-stripped release, it provides a broad corpus of formal mathematical theorem and supporting-lemma statements.
